profile.plan: Three phases: economy and deck engine through Cycle 4 (high-value Crypto, draw, Actions, thinning); a balanced midgame in Cycles 5-8 (attacks, engine, Server Restore and VP each get a share); from Cycle 9 attack the Servers hard and buy mostly VP.

Pure aggression: one or two Cycles of cheap Power and Action cards, then Chaos and Drain from Cycle 3, keeping enough Drain on pace over Cycles 3-12 to destroy both Servers, whatever their integrity, by Cycles 10-13. VP cards only to close out a won race.
Engine: trash weak cards and buy draw, Action and big Crypto through Cycle 7, defend the Servers with Restore, add Chaos only late, then buy heavy VP from Cycle 13.

Pure economy: big Crypto (Kilo-Coin, Mega-Cache), draw and Action cards through Cycle 5, then the most VP the Wallet affords every Draft from Cycle 6, aiming for 25+ VP bought by Cycles 11-14. Restore when the Servers take real damage; Chaos and Drain almost never.
